name: UM Security Division (Bahagian Keselamatan UM - BKU)
shortDescription: Primary 24/7 campus emergency operations control center. Dispatches officers to blocked access gates (PJ Gate / KL Gate), manages storm traffic diversions, and assists stranded students during heavy downpours.

name: UM Department of Development & Estate Maintenance (JPPHB)
shortDescription: Handles physical estate infrastructure, drain unclogging, retention basin maintenance, flood barrier deployments, and electrical substation safety inspections across faculty basements.

name: NADMA Malaysia (National Disaster Management Agency)
shortDescription: National portal providing real-time flood situation maps, active temporary evacuation center (PPS) statuses via InfoBencanaJKM, and standard civil defense flood safety guidelines.

name: Universiti Malaya Student Health Clinic (PKU UM)
shortDescription: On-campus medical triage, acute fluid resuscitation, and emergency care for students experiencing heat exhaustion, severe dehydration, or clinical hyperthermia.

name: MET Malaysia Heatwave Monitoring System
shortDescription: Official daily nationwide heatwave monitoring portal tracking consecutive days above 35°C (Yellow Alert: 35–37°C for 3 days; Orange Alert: 37–40°C; Red Alert: >40°C).

name: Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH) Public Heat Advisories
shortDescription: Statutory clinical health guidelines on identifying heat exhaustion versus life-threatening heat stroke, immediate bystander first aid, and rehydration best practices.

name: Department of Environment APIMS Portal
shortDescription: Official real-time hourly Air Pollutant Index Management System (APIMS) reporting continuous PM2.5 readings for Petaling Jaya (nearest station to UM campus) and Cheras.

name: ASEAN Specialised Meteorological Centre (ASMC)
shortDescription: Regional satellite monitoring agency tracking transboundary smoke haze trajectories, satellite fire hotspot counts, and prevailing Southwest Monsoon wind directions across Southeast Asia.

name: UM Occupational Safety & Health Section (OSH UM)
shortDescription: Oversees university-wide workplace safety guidelines, indoor air quality filtration standards in auditoriums and lecture theatres, and personal protective equipment (PPE/respirator) advisories.

name: Universiti Malaya Sustainability Development Centre (UMSDC)
shortDescription: Central institutional hub driving UM's Eco-Campus master plan, coordinating campus carbon tracking, Rimba Ilmu ecological conservation, and university-wide SDG 13 initiatives.

name: Ministry of Natural Resources & Environmental Sustainability (NRES)
shortDescription: Lead federal ministry overseeing Malaysia's National Climate Change Policy, greenhouse gas inventory reports, carbon commitments under the Paris Agreement, and national adaptation planning.

name: United Nations SDG 13 Knowledge Platform
shortDescription: Global repository providing official target indicators, progress metrics, and educational documentation for Sustainable Development Goal 13: Climate Action (Target 13.3).
sourceOrganization: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs
